papers.title: Health Care Workload Impacts and Cost-Effectiveness of a Metabolomic Risk Score-based Health Check for Cardiometabolic Disease Prevention in Finland
papers.translated_title: 芬兰基于代谢组学风险评分的健康检查对心血管代谢疾病预防的医疗工作负荷影响与成本效益
papers.author: Lavikainen, P.
papers.summary: Background: Predictive metabolomics enables efficient early cardiometabolic risk detection, supporting proactive prevention over traditional reactive healthcare approaches. We evaluated the impact of a novel metabolomic risk score (MRS)-based health check on healthcare workload and long-term cost-effectiveness compared with current practices in Finland's working-age population. Methods: A de novo individual-level microsimulation model was developed to estimate labour time and cost-effectiveness when identifying individuals at risk of cardiometabolic diseases (cardiovascular diseases; CVD or type 2 diabetes; T2D). The model used synthetic data on 256,372 Finnish individuals aged 50-54 years without prior CVD or T2D. From a societal perspective, three scenarios were assessed: 1) replacing the standard health checks with MRS-based health checks, 2) replacing standard health checks with MRS-based checks plus enhanced prevention, and 3) comparing enhanced standard checks with MRS-based checks plus enhanced prevention. Outcomes included time required to identify at-risk individuals, incremental cost-effectiveness ratio per QALY gained, and cost-effectiveness acceptability curves. Results: MRS-based health checks substantially reduce workload, saving 193,140 hours for nurses and 2,843 hours for physicians over five years. The approach is likely cost-saving across all scenarios, with discounted long-term savings ranging from EUR27 million to EUR258 million. In scenarios 1-2, QALYs improve, with gains from 1,316 to 10,813. In scenario 3, no QALY gains are observed, and minor losses occur due to differences in baseline risk stratification. Conclusions: MRS-based health checks in primary and occupational care reduce workload and are likely a cost-saving strategy with potential health outcome benefits in identifying individuals at risk of cardiometabolic diseases.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：预测性代谢组学能够实现高效的早期心血管代谢风险检测，支持从传统被动医疗模式向主动预防转变。我们评估了一种基于新型代谢组学风险评分（MRS）的健康检查对医疗工作量的影响及其长期成本效益，并与芬兰劳动年龄人群的现行实践进行比较。方法：开发了一个全新的个体水平微观模拟模型，用于估算识别心血管代谢疾病（心血管疾病；CVD或2型糖尿病；T2D）风险个体的劳动时间和成本效益。该模型使用了256,372名50-54岁、无既往CVD或T2D的芬兰个体的合成数据。从社会视角评估了三种情景：1）用基于MRS的健康检查替代标准健康检查；2）用基于MRS的检查加增强预防替代标准健康检查；3）比较增强标准检查与基于MRS的检查加增强预防。结局指标包括识别风险个体所需时间、每获得一个QALY的增量成本效益比以及成本效益可接受性曲线。结果：基于MRS的健康检查大幅减少工作量，五年内为护士节省193,140小时，为医生节省2,843小时。该方法在所有情景中均可能节省成本，贴现后的长期节省范围为2700万欧元至2.58亿欧元。在情景1-2中，QALY改善，增益为1,316至10,813。在情景3中，未观察到QALY增益，且由于基线风险分层差异而出现轻微损失。结论：在初级保健和职业保健中采用基于MRS的健康检查可减少工作量，很可能是一种节省成本的策略，并在识别心血管代谢疾病风险个体方面具有潜在的健康结局获益。

papers.title: Primary Care Quality and Inappropriate Community Antibiotic Use: Evidence from Linked Provider and Household Data
papers.translated_title: 初级保健质量与不当社区抗生素使用：来自关联提供者和家庭数据的证据
papers.author: Chen, Y.
papers.summary: Inappropriate antibiotic use presents a major global health challenge, particularly in resource-limited settings where access to quality care remains limited while access to antibiotics is relatively unrestricted. This study estimates the relationship between frontline primary care quality and community antibiotic use, drawing on detailed data from approximately 100 rural villages in China that link objective measures of village doctor clinical practice quality, assessed through unannounced standardized patient visits, to household-level antibiotic use data measured within the same communities. To mitigate potential endogeneity concerns, we employed an instrumental variable (IV) approach integrated within a double/debiased machine learning (DML) framework, using ensemble machine learning to combine information across multiple individually weak but jointly informative provider-level instruments. Higher clinical practice quality was associated with lower probabilities of inappropriate antibiotic receipt during healthcare encounters for cold or diarrhea symptoms (OLS: 6.2 percentage points; DML-IV: 9.6 percentage points) and households storing antibiotics at home for future use (OLS: 4.1 percentage points; DML-IV: 10.9 percentage points). These findings highlight the potential role of improving frontline primary care quality in community antibiotic stewardship. Methodologically, this study illustrates how causal machine learning can complement conventional econometric methods by addressing high-dimensional estimation challenges in global health economics research.
papers.translated_summary: 不恰当的抗生素使用构成了一项重大的全球健康挑战，尤其是在资源有限的环境中，这些地区获得优质医疗服务的机会仍然有限，而获得抗生素的途径相对不受限制。本研究估算了基层初级保健质量与社区抗生素使用之间的关系，利用来自中国约100个农村村庄的详细数据，将通过对村庄医生临床实践质量进行突击标准化患者访问所评估的客观指标，与在同一社区内测量的家庭层面抗生素使用数据相链接。为缓解潜在的内生性问题，我们采用了整合在双重/去偏机器学习（DML）框架内的工具变量（IV）方法，使用集成机器学习将多个单独较弱但联合具有信息量的提供者层面工具的信息结合起来。较高的临床实践质量与因感冒或腹泻症状就医时获得不恰当抗生素的概率较低（OLS：6.2个百分点；DML-IV：9.6个百分点）以及家庭储存抗生素以备将来使用的概率较低（OLS：4.1个百分点；DML-IV：10.9个百分点）相关。这些发现凸显了改善基层初级保健质量在社区抗生素管理中的潜在作用。在方法学上，本研究说明了因果机器学习如何通过解决全球健康经济学研究中的高维估计挑战来补充传统计量经济学方法。

papers.title: Large Language Models to Label CT Radiology Reports for Incidental Findings Found in Lung Cancer Screening: A Comparative Analysis
papers.translated_title: 大型语言模型用于标注肺癌筛查中偶然发现的CT放射学报告：比较分析
papers.author: van der Graaf, F.
papers.summary: In this study, LLM and prompting strategies for labeling Specific Incidental Findings (SIFs) occurring during lung cancer screening, in radiology reports were compared. In this retrospective study, 300 CT reports from a Dutch academic hospital were included between 19th March 2003 and 28th December 2020. GPT-5, GPT-4-Turbo, Llama-3.1-8B-INST, MedGemma-4B-IT, a keyword-based search method, and a radiologist labelled the reports for the presence or absence of nine SIFs. The radiologist's scores were the reference standard. Each LLM was evaluated with four different prompting strategies: two without Chain-of-Thought (CoT), and two with CoT (one zero shot, one few shot). The automated labelling methods were evaluated against the radiologist primarily using Cohen's Kappa, and additionally sensitivity, specificity, and F1 scores. GPT-5 achieved substantial or almost perfect agreement for seven out of nine SIFs: aortic valve disease, bronchiectasis, consolidation, coronary artery calcification, emphysema, abnormality in mediastinal lymph nodes, and thyroid abnormalities, with Cohen $\kappa$ values of 0.81 (0.70, 0.93), 0.97 (0.93, 1.00), 0.71 (0.62, 0.82), 0.92 (0.87, 0.96), 0.91 (0.84, 0.97), 0.71 (0.62, 0.80), and 0.92 (0.86, 0.98) respectively. For the remaining two SIFs, moderate LLM agreement was obtained with MedGemma-4B-IT and with GPT-4-Turbo with Cohen $\kappa$ values of 0.48 (0.40, 0.60), 0.42 (0.31, 0.58) for interstitial lung abnormalities and mediastinal mass respectively. The highest agreement was obtained with the non-CoT prompt strategies for most SIFs. This study demonstrated that LLMs can automatically label radiology reports with agreement ranging from almost perfect to moderate, but not one LLM -- prompt combination achieved the highest agreement across all SIFs.
papers.translated_summary: 本研究比较了用于标注肺癌筛查期间放射学报告中出现的特定偶然发现（Specific Incidental Findings，SIFs）的大语言模型（LLM）及提示策略。在这项回顾性研究中，纳入了荷兰一家学术医院2003年3月19日至2020年12月28日期间的300份CT报告。GPT-5、GPT-4-Turbo、Llama-3.1-8B-INST、MedGemma-4B-IT、一种基于关键词的搜索方法以及一名放射科医师对报告进行了标注，以判断九种SIFs的存在或缺失。以放射科医师的评分为参考标准。每个LLM均采用四种不同的提示策略进行评估：两种不使用思维链（Chain-of-Thought，CoT），两种使用CoT（一种零样本，一种少样本）。自动标注方法主要采用Cohen's Kappa，并辅以灵敏度、特异度和F1分数，与放射科医师进行对比评估。GPT-5在九种SIFs中的七种上达到了显著或几乎完美的一致性：主动脉瓣疾病、支气管扩张、实变、冠状动脉钙化、肺气肿、纵隔淋巴结异常和甲状腺异常，其Cohen $\kappa$ 值分别为0.81（0.70，0.93）、0.97（0.93，1.00）、0.71（0.62，0.82）、0.92（0.87，0.96）、0.91（0.84，0.97）、0.71（0.62，0.80）和0.92（0.86，0.98）。对于其余两种SIFs，MedGemma-4B-IT和GPT-4-Turbo分别获得了中等程度的LLM一致性，间质性肺异常和纵隔肿块的Cohen $\kappa$ 值分别为0.48（0.40，0.60）和0.42（0.31，0.58）。对于大多数SIFs，非CoT提示策略获得了最高的一致性。本研究表明，LLMs可以自动标注放射学报告，其一致性范围从几乎完美到中等不等，但没有任何一种LLM与提示的组合在所有SIFs上均达到最高一致性。

papers.title: Oral rehydration salts and zinc for childhood diarrhoea in Bangladesh, 2019 and 2025: coverage, wealth inequality and reported source of care
papers.translated_title: 2019年和2025年孟加拉国儿童腹泻的口服补液盐和锌：覆盖率、财富不平等和报告的就医来源
papers.author: Hoque, S. M. A. U.
papers.summary: Background: Diarrhoea remains a major cause of morbidity and mortality among children under five. WHO and UNICEF recommend oral rehydration salts (ORS) alongside 10 to 14 days of zinc supplementation. However, national progress in combined treatment coverage and its socioeconomic and care-related inequalities remains insufficiently understood in Bangladesh. We assessed combined coverage, wealth inequality and differences by reported source of care. Methods: In this repeated cross-sectional study, we analysed children under five with caregiver-reported diarrhoea in the 2019 (n=1,589) and 2025 (n=1,634) Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys (MICS). We estimated combined coverage using design-based methods, wealth inequality using slope indices, and associations with source of care using pooled adjusted prevalence ratios (aPR). Demographic and Health Survey (DHS) estimates provided an external comparison. Results: Combined ORS and zinc coverage increased from 35.0% (95% CI 32.3 to 37.7) in 2019 to 42.9% (40.1 to 45.8) in 2025. This was an increase of 7.9 points (4.0 to 11.8). In 2025, ORS and zinc coverage were 75.8% and 51.9%, respectively. The 2025 estimate was similar to DHS 2022 (difference -0.4 points, -7.0 to 6.3), whereas MICS 2019 was below DHS 2017-18. Unadjusted wealth inequality persisted in 2025 (slope index 13.0 percentage points, 3.4 to 22.6). Adjustment for sociodemographic characteristics attenuated the pooled slope index from 11.8 to 6.5 points (-1.7 to 14.6). Coverage was lower with pharmacy-only than public care (aPR 0.59, 0.53 to 0.66) and with no care reported (0.14, 0.11 to 0.18). Children with no care reported accounted for 43.7% of children without combined treatment in 2025. Conclusions: Combined coverage increased within MICS, but fewer than half of children received both, and zinc remained the larger gap. Wealth inequality was partly shared with education and region. Children with no care reported formed the largest group without both treatments and need reaching outside facilities.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：腹泻仍是五岁以下儿童发病和死亡的主要原因。世界卫生组织（WHO）和联合国儿童基金会（UNICEF）建议口服补液盐（ORS）配合10至14天的锌补充剂。然而，孟加拉国在联合治疗覆盖率方面的全国进展及其社会经济和照护相关不平等仍缺乏充分认识。我们评估了联合覆盖率、财富不平等以及按报告的照护来源划分的差异。方法：在这项重复横断面研究中，我们分析了2019年（n=1,589）和2025年（n=1,634）多指标类集调查（MICS）中由照护者报告腹泻的五岁以下儿童。我们使用基于设计的方法估计联合覆盖率，使用斜率指数估计财富不平等，并使用合并调整患病率比（aPR）评估与照护来源的关联。人口与健康调查（DHS）估计值提供了外部比较。结果：ORS和锌联合覆盖率从2019年的35.0%（95% CI 32.3至37.7）上升至2025年的42.9%（40.1至45.8），增加了7.9个百分点（4.0至11.8）。2025年，ORS和锌覆盖率分别为75.8%和51.9%。2025年估计值与DHS 2022相似（差异-0.4个百分点，-7.0至6.3），而MICS 2019低于DHS 2017-18。2025年未调整的财富不平等持续存在（斜率指数13.0个百分点，3.4至22.6）。对社会人口学特征进行调整后，合并斜率指数从11.8个百分点减弱至6.5个百分点（-1.7至14.6）。仅药店照护的覆盖率低于公共卫生照护（aPR 0.59，0.53至0.66），未报告照护的覆盖率更低（0.14，0.11至0.18）。2025年，未报告照护的儿童占未接受联合治疗儿童的43.7%。结论：MICS内部联合覆盖率有所上升，但不到一半的儿童同时接受了两种治疗，锌仍是更大的缺口。财富不平等部分与教育和地区共同存在。未报告照护的儿童构成了未接受两种治疗的最大群体，需要覆盖机构之外的途径。

papers.title: Menstrual Cycle Exacerbation of ADHD Symptoms in Adults: Common, Person-Specific, and Not Confined to the Luteal Phase
papers.translated_title: 成人ADHD症状的月经周期加重：常见、个体特异且不限于黄体期
papers.author: Eisenlohr-Moul, T. A.
papers.summary: Objective. Patients often describe menstrual-cycle worsening of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). We prospectively evaluated sample- and person-level cycle effects on ADHD symptoms and their independence from cyclical negative affect and pain. Methods. In an intensive longitudinal cohort (2019-2024), 106 naturally cycling adults meeting DSM-5 ADHD criteria on integrated assessment rated daily inattention and hyperactivity-impulsivity (Barkley Adult ADHD Rating Scale-IV), negative affect, and pain (median, 41 days) and provided daily salivary estradiol and progesterone for ovulation coding and phase-aligned cycle time (PACTS). Generalized additive models estimated sample-level and person-specific cycle curves; robust cyclicity was tested against each participant's own time-shuffle null. Lab cognitive testing at four counterbalanced phases provided post hoc validation. Results. Sample-average cycle effects were significant yet small (<1% of daily variance), but 54% of 87 participants tested individually were robustly cyclical in ADHD symptoms (95% CI, 44%-64%; inattention 43%, hyperactivity-impulsivity 26%), more often with informant-confirmed ADHD (69% vs 36%). Among them, the cycle explained median 52% and 51% of symptom variance, a mean swing of 2.6 and 2.1 DSM-5 criteria. Most remained cyclical after adjustment for affect (68%) or pain (81%). Worsening most often peaked at and after menses rather than premenstrually; no cycle met prospective criteria for premenstrual dysphoric disorder (PMDD). Hormones did not differ by cyclicity. Conclusions. About half of these adults with ADHD showed robust cyclical symptom change, mostly not reducible to cyclical affect or pain and usually outside the premenstrual window. Future work should test its stability and whether a DSM-5 cyclical specifier is warranted.
papers.translated_summary: 目的。患者常描述注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）随月经周期而加重。我们前瞻性评估了样本层面和个体层面的周期效应对ADHD症状的影响，以及这些效应与周期性负性情绪和疼痛的独立性。方法。在一项密集纵向队列研究（2019—2024年）中，106名符合DSM-5 ADHD标准、经综合评估的自然周期成年女性每日评定注意缺陷和多动-冲动症状（Barkley成人ADHD评定量表-IV）、负性情绪和疼痛（中位数41天），并提供每日唾液雌二醇和孕酮，用于排卵编码和相位对齐的周期时间（PACTS）。采用广义相加模型估计样本层面和个体特异的周期曲线；稳健的周期性检验以每名参与者自身的时间随机置换零模型为对照。在四个平衡相位进行的实验室认知测试提供了事后验证。结果。样本平均的周期效应显著但较小（占每日方差<1%），但在87名逐一检测的参与者中，54%的ADHD症状呈稳健的周期性（95% CI，44%—64%；注意缺陷43%，多动-冲动26%），在经知情者确认的ADHD中更为常见（69% vs 36%）。在其中，周期解释了症状方差的中位数52%和51%，平均波动为2.6和2.1个DSM-5标准。大多数在调整情绪（68%）或疼痛（81%）后仍保持周期性。加重最常峰值出现在月经期及之后，而非经前期；没有一例周期符合经前烦躁障碍（PMDD）的前瞻性标准。激素水平在有无周期性者之间无差异。结论。这些ADHD成人中约半数表现出稳健的周期性症状变化，大多不能归因于周期性情绪或疼痛，且通常不在经前期窗口内。未来研究应检验其稳定性，以及是否有必要设立DSM-5周期性标注。

papers.title: Functional difficulty among children and adolescents aged 5-17 years in Ethiopia: Multilevel analysis of the nationally representative 2024-2025 DHS
papers.translated_title: 埃塞俄比亚5-17岁儿童和青少年的功能性困难：基于2024-2025年全国代表性DHS的多层次分析
papers.author: Hailemariam, M. D.
papers.summary: Background: Population-based data on functional difficulty among school-age children in Ethiopia are scarce. The 2024-2025 Ethiopia Demographic and Health Survey (EDHS) included, for the first time, the UNICEF/Washington Group Child Functioning Module (CFM) for children aged 5-17 years. We estimated the prevalence and domain distribution of functional difficulty and associated factors in Ethiopia. Methods: We analysed cross-sectional EDHS data from 11,122 children aged 5-17 years (weighted n = 10,726) and 4,739 mothers. Functional difficulty was defined as "a lot of difficulty" or "cannot do at all" in any of 11 domains, or daily anxiety or depression. We estimated design-based prevalence and fitted multilevel logistic regression models (children within mothers within clusters) for any, non-affective and affective difficulty. Interviewer effects were examined with random-intercept models and within-cluster comparisons. Results: Overall, 9.5% (95% CI 8.1-11.1) of children had functional difficulty. Daily depression (6.8%) and anxiety (6.6%) dominated, and 70.3% of affected children had only affective difficulty. Difficulty in at least one non-affective domain affected 2.8% (2.2-3.7), with each domain at 0.5-1.4%. Prevalence ranged from 1.5% in Southwest Regional State, Ethiopia, to 16.5% in Oromia Regional State. In adjusted models, children not attending school had higher odds of non-affective difficulty (AOR 2.82, 95% CI 2.01-3.96), and girls had lower odds (AOR 0.63, 0.48-0.84). Outcomes clustered strongly within families (sibling correlation 67.7%) and clusters (ICC 20.9%). Six of 163 interviewers (7.9% of the weighted sample) contributed 58.2% of weighted cases of daily anxiety or depression; in the same clusters they recorded daily symptoms for 56.4% of children, against 2.1% for other interviewers. Excluding 11 statistically outlying interviewers reduced the prevalence of any difficulty to 4.6% (3.6-5.8) and of daily anxiety or depression to 3.3%. The associations with school non-attendance and sex were unchanged. Conclusions: Functional difficulties across the sensory, physical, cognitive, and affective domains, including anxiety or depression, affect about 2-3% of Ethiopian children aged 5-17 years and are strongly associated with being out of school. Appropriate interventions and resource allocation should be considered.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：埃塞俄比亚学龄儿童功能性困难的人群数据十分匮乏。2024-2025年埃塞俄比亚人口与健康调查（EDHS）首次纳入了针对5-17岁儿童的联合国儿童基金会/华盛顿小组儿童功能模块（CFM）。我们估计了埃塞俄比亚功能性困难的患病率、领域分布及相关因素。方法：我们分析了EDHS的横断面数据，涵盖11,122名5-17岁儿童（加权n = 10,726）和4,739名母亲。功能性困难定义为11个领域中任一领域存在“很大困难”或“完全不能做”，或存在每日焦虑或抑郁。我们估计了基于设计的患病率，并拟合了多水平logistic回归模型（儿童嵌套于母亲、母亲嵌套于群组），分别针对任何困难、非情感性困难和情感性困难进行分析。访谈员效应通过随机截距模型和群组内比较进行检验。结果：总体而言，9.5%（95% CI 8.1-11.1）的儿童存在功能性困难。每日抑郁（6.8%）和焦虑（6.6%）占主导地位，70.3%的受影响儿童仅存在情感性困难。至少一个非情感性领域存在困难者占2.8%（2.2-3.7），各领域为0.5-1.4%。患病率从埃塞俄比亚西南区域州的1.5%到奥罗米亚区域州的16.5%不等。在调整模型中，未入学儿童非情感性困难的比值比更高（AOR 2.82，95% CI 2.01-3.96），女童的比值比更低（AOR 0.63，0.48-0.84）。结局在家庭内（同胞相关系数67.7%）和群组内（ICC 20.9%）呈现强聚集性。163名访谈员中有6名（占加权样本的7.9%）贡献了58.2%的加权每日焦虑或抑郁病例；在相同群组中，他们记录了56.4%的儿童存在每日症状，而其他访谈员仅为2.1%。排除11名统计学离群访谈员后，任何困难的患病率降至4.6%（3.6-5.8），每日焦虑或抑郁降至3.3%。与失学和性别的关联未发生变化。结论：感觉、躯体、认知和情感领域（包括焦虑或抑郁）的功能性困难影响约2-3%的5-17岁埃塞俄比亚儿童，且与失学密切相关。应考虑采取适当的干预措施和资源配置。

papers.title: Mucin VNTR haplogroup associations with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis are not independent of rs35705950
papers.translated_title: 黏蛋白VNTR单倍群与特发性肺纤维化的关联并非独立于rs35705950
papers.author: Reynolds, C.
papers.summary: Background: The MUC5B promoter variant (rs35705950) is the strongest common genetic risk factor for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF). MUC5B and MUC5AC contain variable number tandem repeat (VNTR) regions. Long-read sequencing resolves MUC5AC into three SNP-tagged haplogroups (H1, H2, H3) differing in repeat length, and MUC5B into two (H1, H2) differing in lineage but not length. The tags correlate with rs35705950, so whether a haplogroup effect is distinguishable from the promoter variant is unclear. Methods: We assigned MUC5AC and MUC5B haplogroups from imputed chromosome 11 array data in 771 European-ancestry IPF Job Exposures Study participants (385 cases, 386 controls). Logistic regression adjusted for age, smoking, principal components and centre, with and without rs35705950. The same models were fitted in TOPMed (1,961 cases, 3,816 controls). Results: MUC5AC H3 and MUC5B H1 were each associated with IPF (H3 OR 1.63, 95% CI 1.26-2.09, p=1.8x10-4; MUC5B H1 OR 0.71, 0.52-0.98, p=0.038). Both attenuated on adjustment for rs35705950 (H3 OR 1.10, 0.83-1.45, p=0.52; MUC5B H1 OR 0.82, 0.58-1.15, p=0.25). A MUC5AC H2 association persisted after adjustment (OR 0.69, 0.51-0.94, p=0.017). In TOPMed the H3 findings replicated (unadjusted OR 1.62, 1.47-1.78, p<10-15; adjusted 0.94, 0.84-1.05, p=0.26), but the rs35705950-adjusted H2 association did not: the estimate was null overall (OR 0.99, 0.88-1.11, p=0.87) and in men and women separately (1.00, 0.87-1.16; 0.97, 0.79-1.19). The MUC5B tag failed quality control in TOPMed. Conclusions: The MUC5AC H3 and MUC5B H1 associations are not independent of rs35705950. The MUC5AC H2 association seen here did not replicate. VNTR haplogroup does not appear to contribute to IPF risk independently of rs35705950.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：MUC5B启动子变异（rs35705950）是特发性肺纤维化（IPF）最强的常见遗传风险因素。MUC5B和MUC5AC包含可变数目串联重复（VNTR）区域。长读长测序将MUC5AC解析为三个由SNP标记的单倍群（H1、H2、H3），其重复长度不同；将MUC5B解析为两个（H1、H2），其谱系不同但长度相同。这些标签与rs35705950相关，因此单倍群效应是否可与启动子变异区分尚不清楚。方法：我们从771名欧洲血统IPF职业暴露研究参与者（385例病例，386例对照）的推算11号染色体芯片数据中确定MUC5AC和MUC5B单倍群。逻辑回归模型调整年龄、吸烟、主成分和中心，分别纳入和不纳入rs35705950。相同的模型在TOPMed中拟合（1,961例病例，3,816例对照）。结果：MUC5AC H3和MUC5B H1均与IPF相关（H3 OR 1.63，95% CI 1.26-2.09，p=1.8x10-4；MUC5B H1 OR 0.71，0.52-0.98，p=0.038）。两者在调整rs35705950后均减弱（H3 OR 1.10，0.83-1.45，p=0.52；MUC5B H1 OR 0.82，0.58-1.15，p=0.25）。MUC5AC H2的关联在调整后持续存在（OR 0.69，0.51-0.94，p=0.017）。在TOPMed中，H3的发现得到重复（未调整OR 1.62，1.47-1.78，p<10-15；调整后0.94，0.84-1.05，p=0.26），但调整rs35705950后的H2关联未能重复：总体估计值为无效（OR 0.99，0.88-1.11，p=0.87），在男性和女性中分别亦为无效（1.00，0.87-1.16；0.97，0.79-1.19）。MUC5B标签在TOPMed中未通过质量控制。结论：MUC5AC H3和MUC5B H1的关联并非独立于rs35705950。此处观察到的MUC5AC H2关联未能重复。VNTR单倍群似乎并不独立于rs35705950对IPF风险作出贡献。

papers.title: Assessing the Accuracy of the NeuroBooster Array for GBA1 Variant Detection
papers.translated_title: 评估NeuroBooster阵列检测GBA1变异的准确性
papers.author: Toffoli, M.
papers.summary: GBA1 variants are major Parkinson's disease risk factors, but their detection is challenging. We compared NeuroBooster Array (NBA) genotyping with reference sequencing in 3,744 individuals. NBA correctly identified 520/608 carriers (85.5%). Of 89 missed calls, 73 had no matching probe and 16 had missing calls. 25 participants had false positive calls. NBA should not be used alone for clinical decisions, but is very useful for case control analysis.
papers.translated_summary: GBA1变异是帕金森病的主要风险因素，但其检测具有挑战性。我们在3,744名个体中比较了NeuroBooster Array（NBA）基因分型与参考测序。NBA正确识别了520/608名携带者（85.5%）。在89例漏检中，73例无匹配探针，16例为缺失调用。25名参与者出现假阳性调用。NBA不应单独用于临床决策，但对于病例对照分析非常有用。

papers.title: Pooled Multiplex Amplicon Massive Parallel Sequencing for High-Throughput Confirmation of Whole-Genome Sequencing Potentially Pathogenic Variants in Patients with Parkinsonism
papers.translated_title: pooled multiplex amplicon massive parallel sequencing用于高通量确认全基因组测序在帕金森综合征患者中潜在致病性变异
papers.author: Vrtel, R.
papers.summary: Whole-genome sequencing identifies large numbers of genetic variants, although only a subset requires independent confirmation for clinical interpretation. Sanger sequencing remains the standard confirmation method but is impractical for large-scale variant verification. We developed and evaluated a strategy for variant confirmation based on multi-amplicon massively parallel sequencing of pooled DNA samples. Whole-genome sequencing data were obtained from 86 individuals, including patients with parkinsonism and controls. Variants were selected using phenotype-driven filtering, ClinVar classification, and pathogenicity assessment criteria. A total of 307 variants were targeted using a custom amplicon panel comprising 290 amplicons. DNA samples were normalized, pooled into 16 mixtures, and sequenced following automated library preparation. Variant presence and sequencing quality were assessed using standard bioinformatic tools. Of the 307 selected variants, 243 were successfully confirmed. Unconfirmed variants included sequencing artifacts (18), insufficiently covered targets (5), large insertions or deletions exceeding 12 base pairs (36), and variants located within homopolymeric regions (5). Results for selected variants were concordant with Sanger sequencing, and observed variant frequencies corresponded to expected frequencies in pooled samples. This approach provides a robust, rapid, and cost-effective method for high-throughput genetic variants confirming identified by whole-genome sequencing while requiring only limited DNA input. Despite complete concordance with Sanger sequencing, larger validation studies are needed before multi-amplicon massively parallel sequencing can replace routine confirmatory testing.
papers.translated_summary: 全基因组测序可识别大量遗传变异，但仅有一部分需要独立确认以用于临床解读。Sanger测序仍是标准的确认方法，但用于大规模变异验证不切实际。我们开发并评估了一种基于混合DNA样本的多扩增子大规模平行测序的变异确认策略。全基因组测序数据来自86个个体，包括帕金森综合征患者和对照。采用表型驱动过滤、ClinVar分类和致病性评估标准选择变异。使用包含290个扩增子的定制扩增子panel靶向307个变异。DNA样本经标准化后混合成16个混合池，并在自动化文库制备后测序。使用标准生物信息学工具评估变异存在情况和测序质量。在307个所选变异中，243个被成功确认。未确认的变异包括测序伪影（18个）、覆盖不足的靶标（5个）、超过12个碱基对的大插入或缺失（36个）以及位于同聚区域的变异（5个）。所选变异的结果与Sanger测序一致，观察到的变异频率与混合样本中的预期频率相符。该方法为全基因组测序识别的高通量遗传变异确认提供了一种稳健、快速且经济有效的方法，同时仅需有限的DNA输入。尽管与Sanger测序完全一致，但在多扩增子大规模平行测序能够取代常规确认检测之前，仍需更大规模的验证研究。

papers.title: Routine health information system data quality in a hill and mountain district of Nepal: a cross-sectional desk review of four years of DHIS2 data from Sankhuwasabha, 2021-2025
papers.translated_title: 尼泊尔一个丘陵和山区的常规卫生信息系统数据质量：对桑库瓦萨巴2021-2025年四年DHIS2数据的横断面案头审查
papers.author: Shrestha, D.
papers.summary: Introduction. Nepal's routine health information system runs on DHIS2, but no published data-quality assessment covers its mountainous districts. The method raises a second issue: the WHO Data Quality Review (DQR) tests internal consistency partly through related-indicator pairs, assuming each indicator is recorded independently. DHIS2 validation rules act on paired values at entry, so a rule-governed pair may agree for reasons unrelated to recording quality. Methods. In this study, a WHO DQR Module 1 desk review was conducted on aggregated DHIS2 data from all 132 facilities in Sankhuwasabha district, analysed at district and local level (palika) resolution: seven datasets for completeness and timeliness, and 17 tracer indicators for internal consistency, for fiscal year 2081/82 (2024/25) against the three preceding years (2021/22 to 2023/24). Pairs were classified in advance as rule-governed or free, and three denominator-free ratios compared with Nepal Demographic and Health Survey (NDHS) 2022 estimates for Koshi Province. Results. Completeness was at least 90.6% in every dataset and unit. Timeliness fell below 90% in 22 of 70 unit-dataset combinations, concentrated in four remote local levels. Of four rule-governed pairs only iron and deworming changed materially, 1.42 to 1.00; two never agreed, indicating rules that query rather than block entry. The free pairs diverged: Penta-1 to Penta-3 dropout fell from +3.6% to -5.4%, negative in 9 of 10 local levels, and BCG was below Penta-1 in 8 of 10. District totals were inverted at both steps (BCG 1,537, Penta-1 1,666, Penta-3 1,756), which redistribution cannot produce. Conclusion. Reporting is nearly complete, but the data carry a persistent immunization anomaly that completeness and timeliness miss, pointing to a systematic recording process. Because a rule-governed pair may agree by configuration, DHIS2 assessments should classify pairs against the active validation-rule set before interpretation.
papers.translated_summary: 引言。尼泊尔的常规卫生信息系统运行于DHIS2平台，但尚无已发表的数据质量评估覆盖其山区县。该方法引出第二个问题：世界卫生组织数据质量审查（DQR）部分通过相关指标配对来检验内部一致性，其假设每个指标均被独立记录。DHIS2验证规则在录入时对配对值起作用，因此受规则约束的配对可能因与记录质量无关的原因而一致。方法。本研究对桑库瓦萨巴县全部132家机构的DHIS2汇总数据进行了WHO DQR模块1案头审查，在县和地方层级（palika）分辨率上分析：七个数据集用于完整性和及时性，17个追踪指标用于内部一致性，覆盖2081/82财年（2024/25）及前三个年度（2021/22至2023/24）。配对事先被分类为规则约束型或自由型，并将三个无分母比率与尼泊尔 demographic and health survey（NDHS）2022年科西省估计值进行比较。结果。每个数据集和单位的完整性均至少为90.6%。及时性在70个单位-数据集组合中有22个低于90%，集中在四个偏远地方层级。四个规则约束型配对中仅铁剂和驱虫药发生实质性变化，从1.42降至1.00；两个配对从未一致，表明规则是查询而非阻止录入。自由型配对出现分化：Penta-1至Penta-3的脱落率从+3.6%降至-5.4%，在10个地方层级中有9个为负值，BCG在10个中有8个低于Penta-1。县总计在两个步骤上均出现倒置（BCG 1,537，Penta-1 1,666，Penta-3 1,756），这是重新分配无法产生的。结论。报告几乎完整，但数据携带持续存在的免疫异常，而完整性和及时性未能捕捉到，指向系统性记录过程。由于规则约束型配对可能因配置而一致，DHIS2评估应在解释前依据现行验证规则集对配对进行分类。
